answer: A horizon marble probation with a public sonnet makes every new alias earn entry over 30 days. Each alias publishes a short sonnet about its skills, and every finished job adds one marble to its public count. A new alias takes only jobs under 50 POA until it holds 5 marbles, so 100 fake aliases need 500 finished jobs before any touches big pay. Five marbles all from one requester, or identical sonnets across aliases, flag the alias at once. Flagged aliases lose their 30 POA deposit, their marbles are wiped, and they sit out the next 14 epochs while a checker reviews each job.
